program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    month_offset = (dt.month - 1) * 31 * 86400
    day_offset = (dt.day - 1) * 86400
    time_seconds = dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second
    monotonic_seconds = month_offset + day_offset + time_seconds
    return {'stored': [monotonic_seconds], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    monotonic_seconds = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record['layout']
    sp1, sp2, day_width = layout
    days_in_month = 31
    month = monotonic_seconds // (days_in_month * 86400) + 1
    remaining_seconds = monotonic_seconds % (days_in_month * 86400)
    day = remaining_seconds // 86400 + 1
    time_seconds = remaining_seconds % 86400
    hour = time_seconds // 3600
    minute = (time_seconds % 3600) // 60
    second = time_seconds % 60
    dt = datetime(2024, month, day, hour, minute, second)  # Arbitrary year
    month_text = dt.strftime('%b')
    day_text = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    time_text = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    return month_text + (' ' * sp1) + day_text + (' ' * sp2) + time_text
